title.narrative: ENACT III - Enhancing African capacity to respond more effectively to transnational organised crime (TOC)

description.narrative: Contract related to: ENACT III - Enhancing African capacity to respond more effectively to transnational organised crime (TOC) - The overall objective of the action is to contribute to the disruption of criminal networks trafficking drugs and other illicit commodities, organised crime and trafficking of human beings, along main trafficking routes. This objective will be pursued mainly through the Global Illicit Flows Programme, an umbrella programme under which the support to joint airport interdiction task forces and their cooperation, to law enforcement units charged with the monitoring and control of trafficking via general aviation, and to transnational criminal justice cooperation, promotion of ethics and integrity as well as researching and informing partners of the associated risks will be an important development in 2021.
